description: The bar chart, titled "Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks," illustrates the performance scores of two different models across nine datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Dataset and Metrics," and lists the following datasets from left to right: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with the labels rotated diagonally. The vertical axis is the value axis, labeled "Score (%)," featuring a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The chart uses grouped vertical bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a pair of side-by-side bars. According to the legend titled "Model," the blue bars positioned on the left of each group represent "LLaMA-3-8B-it," and the orange bars on the right represent "Ours (Iterative RLHF)." The bars vary in height across the categories, with the highest scores observed in the GSM-8K category, where the blue and orange bars reach approximately 79% and 80%, respectively. The lowest scores are found in the Chat-Arena-Hard category, where the blue bar is at roughly 20% and the orange bar is near 29%. Other approximate values include MMLU (blue 66%, orange 65%), HumanEval (blue 61%, orange 64%), TruthfulQA (blue 44%, orange 60%), ARC (blue 59%, orange 64%), MBPP (blue 61%, orange 61%), LC AlpacaEval-2 (blue 23%, orange 31%), and MT-Bench (x5) (blue 41%, orange 42%). The categories are not sorted in a strictly ascending, descending, or alphabetical order, and there are no visually emphasized bars.
caption_used: The bar chart titled 'Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks' compares the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), across nine datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis is labeled 'Dataset and Metrics,' with categories including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents 'Score (%)' on a linear scale from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10%. Both models perform similarly on GSM-8K, achieving scores of approximately 80%. On MMLU, LLaMA-3-8B-it slightly outperforms Ours (Iterative RLHF) with a score of 70% compared to 65%. For HumanEval, Ours (Iterative RLHF) shows a notable improvement, scoring 70% compared to LLaMA-3-8B-it's 60%. TruthfulQA demonstrates a consistent upward trend for both models, with Ours (Iterative RLHF) reaching 65% and LLaMA-3-8B-it trailing at 45%. ARC and MBPP show identical performance for both models at 60%. LC AlpacaEval-2 and MT-Bench (×5) exhibit modest scores, with Ours (Iterative RLHF) slightly outperforming LLaMA-3-8B-it. Chat-Arena-Hard shows the lowest scores, with both models performing below 30%. Overall, Ours (Iterative RLHF) consistently outperforms LLaMA-3-8B-it across most benchmarks, particularly in HumanEval and TruthfulQA, demonstrating its superior generalization capabilities.
